questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: The long history of make-up in ancient times
How to become rich quickly by posting videos online
Two beauty influencers and how they work online
Why traditional jobs are disappearing in the UK
questions.why: Sam says they'll meet two beauty influencers from Nigeria and Pakistan who are changing attitudes to beauty.

questions.q: Why does Sam talk about the card game Happy Families?
options: To contrast old jobs with new online ones
Because it is her favourite childhood game
To show that families should work together
Because influencers often promote card games
questions.why: The game has traditional jobs like baker and tailor; Neil says a 21st-century list would include jobs like YouTuber.

questions.q: What kind of videos has Dimma Umeh been making?
options: Cooking videos filmed in markets in Lagos
Photography lessons for young beginners
Face painting designs for children's parties
Make-up tutorials for women of colour
questions.why: Neil says she's been creating make-up video tutorials for women of colour for eight years.

questions.q: What made Dimma's 2017 video become so popular?
options: It was the first make-up video made in Nigeria
She made it funny by telling jokes
A famous company paid to promote it
It showed her shopping with celebrities
questions.why: Others had made similar videos, but Dimma did hers 'in a way that was a bit funny' and cracked jokes.

questions.q: What did Rammal Mehmud do before becoming a make-up artist?
options: She was a photographer
She was a school teacher
She worked as a doctor
She sold make-up in a shop
questions.why: Neil describes her as 'a photographer turned make-up artist' in Islamabad.

questions.q: According to Rammal, how did face painting help her?
options: It helped her win an important art prize
It helped her find a job with a big company
It helped her get through depression
It helped her meet her husband and friends
questions.why: Neil says her colourful face painting designs helped her through a period of depression.

questions.q: What does Rammal do to protect her family and friends?
options: She never posts anything about her private life
She only lets her followers see photos of herself
She stops followers asking personal questions
She asks people if they're happy to be shown
questions.why: She says you have to ask people if they are comfortable being on your platform or not.

questions.q: What does Sam find most amazing about Dimma and Rammal?
options: How much money they both make from companies
They start talks about what beauty means
How many products they manage to sell each day
How quickly they both became famous on TV
questions.why: Sam says what's amazing is how they use social media to start conversations about what beauty means to women.
